name: Chao san ca loc
summary: Cháo sắn cá lóc is a bowl the Đồng Hới ward office names on Tôn Đức Thắng, Nguyễn Thái Học, and at the Hà Huy Tập–Hoàng Diệu junction. The office does not say how the bowl is cooked.
origin: Đồng Hới. Named by the ward office, without a method.
howToEat: A method was not printed. Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
where: Tôn Đức Thắng, Nguyễn Thái Học beside the Nam Lý kindergarten, and the junction of Hà Huy Tập and Hoàng Diệu. Those are the streets on the ward list.
seoTitle: Chao san ca loc in Dong Hoi
seoDescription: The Dong Hoi ward office names cháo sắn cá lóc on Tôn Đức Thắng, Nguyễn Thái Học, and at Hà Huy Tập–Hoàng Diệu. A method and a price are Check on arrival.
